# Plan 14 as one dependency graph. Run order and ownership: 14_index.md. Every phase is an ordinary
# tradeoffs-trace run (worker + M/A/B reviewers, 3 repair rounds); the scheduler starts a node when
# every node it waits for is DONE.
#
#   14a Redstone live ──┐
#   14b Kaiko HFR crypto┼──► 14g split re-gate ──► 14h n≥4 blend (DEFERRED, owner confirmation)
#   14c restart ────────┤
#   14d broker loss ────┤
#   14e publish+health ─┤
#   14f K5/K4 ──────────┘
#
# `#+TT_PROGRAM: 6` lets 14a-14f (six independent phases) run at once. `#+TT_BRANCHES: stack` gives
# one branch (and PR) per phase, cut from its dependencies:
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--14a … --14f   <- feat/atlas-ips-next (six siblings: two vendor phases,
#                                          four robustness phases, disjoint file sets)
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--14g           <- a merge commit of --14a … --14f
#
# 14a and 14b are vendor phases (adapter crate + one fragment each). 14c-14f are split-robustness
# phases, all inside crates/services/index/{index-subscriber-service,index-calculator-service} and
# docker/docker-compose.yml. They touch disjoint files, so the six siblings merge cleanly at the 14g
# join. **Nothing in plan 14 touches crates/modules/index/calculator/** — the n≥4 blend is 14h,
# parked until the owner confirms the logic.
#
# ── ONE manual precondition ──
# Plan 13 must be in the base before 14a starts. Either merge the plan-13 stack into feat/atlas and
# re-cut this branch, or fast-forward it to the plan-13 tip:
#   cd /Users/angold.wang/Work/dragon
#   git fetch origin
#   git branch -f feat/atlas-ips-next feat/atlas-ips-next--13j   # + the #1247 deploy fix
#   git push -u origin feat/atlas-ips-next
